$about: This repo's site, in the ecosystem's shared form (tools/docsite.mjs). Any repo can carry this file and run the core's generator against its own markdown - one form, many sites, zero copied generators. Omitted fields fall back to the core's defaults.
$layout: ADR-031: one domain, surface first. This is the core, so it takes the unprefixed pair - site_root '/' and base_path '/docs/', both defaults, which is why neither is written here. A stack sets site_root '/node/' and base_path '/docs/node/' and changes nothing else.
